prompts.name: 왕관 보석
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent collectible sprite for a hand-painted storybook 2D platform game. Input reference is ONLY the existing yellow star's soft glossy painted rendering and readable dark edge, not its star shape. Primary subject: A tiny three-point royal GOLD CROWN, rounded broad tips, a large faceted raspberry ruby in the center of its band and two small lilac stones. A compact crown-shaped treasure, with a clear wide crown silhouette. The crown itself is the entire collectible; no head, no face, no pedestal. Front view, centered isolated object filling around 70 percent of a square canvas, complete silhouette with generous transparent margins on all sides. Warm top-left light, soft painted gouache texture, rich beveled highlights, restrained dark plum outline, child-friendly polished fantasy-game art. Designed to remain instantly recognizable when downsampled to 64 pixels. A cohesive gold-edged treasure style, simple bold forms, very few large facets. Genuine transparent alpha background. No five-point stars, no eyes or face, no text, letters, numbers, sparkles outside the main silhouette, cast shadow, glow halo, scenery, UI frame, watermark or additional objects. Exactly one item, not a sheet or contact sheet.
